response.sql: WITH operator_metrics AS (SELECT crewref, AVG(CAST(gbsize AS REAL) / spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0 GROUP BY crewref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS overall_avg_gb_per_min FROM operator_metrics), top_operators AS (SELECT om.crewref, om.avg_gb_per_min, om.scan_count, oa.overall_avg_gb_per_min FROM operator_metrics om CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE om.avg_gb_per_min > oa.overall_avg_gb_per_min) SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scans_per_operator, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_per_min - overall_avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_excess FROM top_operators;

assumptions.assumption: Scans with NULL gbsize, NULL spanmin, or spanmin ≤ 0 are excluded (to handle missing values and avoid undefined division)
"the simple average of that figure across all operators" means the average of per-operator averages (equal weight per operator)

alternatives.interpretation: "the simple average of that figure across all operators" could mean the average of gbsize/spanmin across all scans (per-scan weighting instead of per-operator weighting)
